authorization.request: 用户明确要求商城展示可搜索的完整插件目录，并为插件提供 DSH Desktop 安装入口；收录和审核状态用于建议，最终安装结果由 DSH Desktop 判断。

objective: 让 DSH Desktop 商城分别提供审核记录、官网推荐榜、必装榜和可搜索的完整插件目录。公开发现、Catalog 和 Store 候选中的 DSH 插件都提供逐次确认的 GitHub 安装入口；Store 收录/审核状态作为建议展示，最终是否安装成功由 DSH Desktop 判断。

websiteSnapshot.integrity: ranking index HTML publishes the SHA-256 of the ranking data; both files are served from GitHub Pages

directorySnapshot.integrity: The official directory uses the published discovery index, Catalog index, and candidate registry, merged by source identity, package name, and repository; counts are snapshot-specific

change.storeViews: Separate full directory, Catalog review records, official recommended ranking, essential ranking, and Desktop installed views. Full-directory search, filters, and pagination cover the website's merged discovery/Catalog/candidate rows. Recommended and essential rankings use the website ranking snapshot and its published SHA-256, with website-equivalent ranking and pagination; placement never changes review status or installation eligibility.
change.installAuthority: Store 显示收录、审核和风险建议；公开 dsh-plugin 的 GitHub 来源经基本格式与保护对象校验后，可由用户确认并提交给 DSH installBundle。DSH inspect 只作提示；DSH installBundle 返回及一次按仓库来源核对的 listBundles 回读决定成功、失败或未知状态，不自动重试。
change.sourceSelection: 公开目录直装使用 canonical GitHub 仓库 URL，不伪称其为 Catalog 审核固定 Commit；Catalog 的既有 approved/blocked 固定 Commit 入口继续保留。
change.excludedTargets: 未被识别为 DSH 插件的生态应用/生态插件、商城自身、@deepseek-ai/*、受保护官方组件和格式无效的仓库不显示插件直装入口。Store 候选审核未通过不会阻断用户确认后的 DSH 检查。
change.catalog: Source PR 不改变 Catalog 状态或 pin；源码合并后才创建新的 Catalog policy plan 发布 0.9.30。
change.runtime: 不修改 DSH 核心、不写真实 Profile、不重启 DSH、不执行第三方源码。仅在用户确认后调用 DSH Desktop 官方 pluginManager。

gates: This fresh plan binds the current base Commit, exact file scope, and base SHA-256 values; CI runs the typed plan verifier.

The recommended and essential views read the same published ranking snapshot as the website, verify its digest from the paired ranking-page HTML, and validate bounded schema/counts before rendering. If that snapshot is unavailable, those views report unavailable while the full directory remains usable.

The recommended ranking preserves author-interaction evidence, weekly star picks, official-tool placements, and source review status. The essential ranking preserves the website's category winners and labelled category supplements; neither is represented as a security audit or universal install requirement.

A canonical public GitHub repository uses the direct route when the row is an official discovery dsh-plugin, has a Catalog record, or has a DSH Store candidate record. Candidate-only and unlisted Catalog rows are not suppressed by their Store review state. Unclassified ecosystem apps/plugins, protected packages and malformed repositories remain excluded.

The direct route requires a per-operation confirmation that names the exact GitHub repository and explicitly identifies the default-branch source. It calls only the DSH Desktop official installBundle API.

Catalog listing, review, featured/recommended state, candidate verdicts, and compatibility notes remain visible advice; none of them report DSH installation success. Existing approved/blocked fixed-Commit actions remain available.

DSH inspect is advisory. DSH applied/restart-required results are displayed as returned; failed or uncertain requests are reconciled once against the GitHub repository in listBundles, and never resubmitted automatically.
Use disposable Desktop fixtures. Run the focused Desktop suite, npm run check, package dry run, typed plan verifier, and git diff --check; require exact-head CI before merge.

After source merge, use a separate fresh Catalog plan and independently read back GitHub Raw, Pages, dsh.store, and dsh-store.cn. Real Desktop UI/Profile acceptance remains separate and unverified until exercised in the app.
rollback: Revert only this source change through an auditable CI-checked PR. Do not change any real DSH Profile or package. Keep the Catalog on its current pin unless a separate Catalog policy plan is approved and verified.
healthCheck: Require DSH_UPGRADE_PLAN_OK, focused disposable Desktop tests, npm run check, npm pack dry run, git diff --check, and exact-head PR CI. After the separate Catalog release, perform four independent public readbacks. Do not infer real Desktop UI acceptance from tests.

commands.expected: all disposable Desktop interaction and direct GitHub install cases pass
REGISTRY_OK and all repository checks pass
